g.text: This AON-powered hardware chain grants two latched permissions.

g.desc: This AON-powered hardware chain grants two latched permissions.

g.text: GLOBAL_PWR_PERMIT enables the switched MIRA supplies; MATRIX_PERMIT

g.desc: GLOBAL_PWR_PERMIT enables the switched MIRA supplies; MATRIX_PERMIT

g.text: allows the downstream matrix and programming circuits to operate.

g.desc: allows the downstream matrix and programming circuits to operate.

g.text: A fault clears permission and requires an explicit re-arm.

g.desc: A fault clears permission and requires an explicit re-arm.

g.text: R2602/R2605 (10 kOhm) pull the stop lines HIGH; closing J2601/J2602

g.desc: R2602/R2605 (10 kOhm) pull the stop lines HIGH; closing J2601/J2602

g.text: or asserting a kill GPIO pulls them LOW. R2601/R2604/R2606/R2607

g.desc: or asserting a kill GPIO pulls them LOW. R2601/R2604/R2606/R2607

g.text: (100 kOhm) hold kill and arm inputs LOW when released. There is no

g.desc: (100 kOhm) hold kill and arm inputs LOW when released. There is no

g.text: RC delay: firmware must send clean arm edges after conditions settle.

g.desc: RC delay: firmware must send clean arm edges after conditions settle.

g.text: A global fault clears both permissions; a matrix fault clears only

g.desc: A global fault clears both permissions; a matrix fault clears only

g.text: matrix permission. Fault recovery alone does not re-arm either latch.

g.desc: matrix permission. Fault recovery alone does not re-arm either latch.

g.text: Sheets 5200/5300 block startup outputs and qualify GLOBAL_CLEAR_N.

g.desc: Sheets 5200/5300 block startup outputs and qualify GLOBAL_CLEAR_N.

g.text: AON_RESET_N remains in the clear chain. The stop connectors trip

g.desc: AON_RESET_N remains in the clear chain. The stop connectors trip

g.text: when closed; an open cable is not detected as a stop.

g.desc: when closed; an open cable is not detected as a stop.

g.text: Requires rails, commands and host ready

g.desc: Requires rails, commands and host ready

g.text: Explicit rising-edge re-arm after a fault

g.desc: Explicit rising-edge re-arm after a fault

g.text: U2601 combines the global conditions; U2602 combines matrix conditions.

g.desc: U2601 combines the global conditions; U2602 combines matrix conditions.

g.text: Their outputs drive the two active-low clears of U2603. With D HIGH

g.desc: Their outputs drive the two active-low clears of U2603. With D HIGH

g.text: and preset inactive, a rising PWR_ARM_PULSE or MATRIX_ARM_PULSE

g.desc: and preset inactive, a rising PWR_ARM_PULSE or MATRIX_ARM_PULSE

g.text: sets the corresponding permission only while its clear is HIGH.

g.desc: sets the corresponding permission only while its clear is HIGH.

g.text: Global inputs cover input power, AON reset, PM watchdog/reset,

g.desc: Global inputs cover input power, AON reset, PM watchdog/reset,

g.text: overcurrent and global stop. Matrix inputs add rail/command

g.desc: overcurrent and global stop. Matrix inputs add rail/command

g.text: readiness, host watchdog/reset, LINK_READY_H and matrix stop.

g.desc: readiness, host watchdog/reset, LINK_READY_H and matrix stop.

g.text: J2603 exports MATRIX_PERMIT and raw MATRIX_KILL_H.

g.desc: J2603 exports MATRIX_PERMIT and raw MATRIX_KILL_H.

g.text: Application heartbeat qualification is on sheet 5400.

g.desc: Application heartbeat qualification is on sheet 5400.
